name: Algebraic Cut-Size Obfuscation
description: Replaces the binary pairwise exclusion constraint (Independent Set) with a mathematically equivalent equality constraint involving the graph cut size and sum of degrees. By requiring the number of cut edges to equal the sum of degrees of the selected vertices, it algebraically enforces that the selected vertices have zero internal edges. LLMs will implement the equality check directly, failing to recognize the Independent Set structure required to apply the necessary branch-and-bound pruning, resulting in a Time Limit Exceeded on large inputs.
